CHEMISTRY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: CHEMISTRY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Alkanols 3.2 Alkanoic acid 3.3 Detergents 3.4 Polymers Page 12 of 40 1 STRAND 1.? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Alkanols 3.2 Alkanoic acid 3.3 Detergents 3.4 Polymers Page 12 of 40 1 STRAND 1..
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Alkanols 3.2 Alkanoic acid 3.3 Detergents 3.4 Polymers Page 12 of 40 1 STRAND 1..
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Alkanols 3.2 Alkanoic acid 3.3 Detergents 3.4 Polymers Page 12 of 40 1 STRAND 1..
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Alkanols 3.2 Alkanoic acid 3.3 Detergents 3.4 Polymers Page 12 of 40 1 STRAND 1..

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Alkanoic acids ● Introduction to alkanoic acids, ● Nomenclature ● Preparation of? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Alkanoic acids ● Introduction to alkanoic acids, ● Nomenclature ● Preparation of.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Alkanoic acids ● Introduction to alkanoic acids, ● Nomenclature ● Preparation of.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Alkanoic acids ● Introduction to alkanoic acids, ● Nomenclature ● Preparation of.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Alkanoic acids ● Introduction to alkanoic acids, ● Nomenclature ● Preparation of.

3. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

4. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Removing all vegetation

5. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Producers
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Decomposers only

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy Changes in physical and chemical processes 2.2. Electrochemistry 2.3 Nucl? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Energy Changes in physical and chemical processes 2.2. Electrochemistry 2.3 Nucl.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy Changes in physical and chemical processes 2.2. Electrochemistry 2.3 Nucl.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Energy Changes in physical and chemical processes 2.2. Electrochemistry 2.3 Nucl.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Energy Changes in physical and chemical processes 2.2. Electrochemistry 2.3 Nucl.

7. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 100 °C

8. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. joule (J)
   D. newton (N)

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Detergents 3.4 Polymers Page 12 of 40 1 STRAND 1.0: INORGANIC CHEMISTRY Strand S? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Detergents 3.4 Polymers Page 12 of 40 1 STRAND 1.0: INORGANIC CHEMISTRY Strand S.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Detergents 3.4 Polymers Page 12 of 40 1 STRAND 1.0: INORGANIC CHEMISTRY Strand S.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Detergents 3.4 Polymers Page 12 of 40 1 STRAND 1.0: INORGANIC CHEMISTRY Strand S.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Detergents 3.4 Polymers Page 12 of 40 1 STRAND 1.0: INORGANIC CHEMISTRY Strand S.

10. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy Changes in physical and chemical processes ● System and surrounding ● Ene? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Energy Changes in physical and chemical processes ● System and surrounding ● Ene.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Energy Changes in physical and chemical processes ● System and surrounding ● Ene.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Energy Changes in physical and chemical processes ● System and surrounding ● Ene.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy Changes in physical and chemical processes ● System and surrounding ● Ene.

12. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. Movement of water only across a membrane
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Energy Changes in physical and chemical processes ● System and surrounding ● Ene and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Electrochemistry 2.3 Nuclear chemistry 3.0 Organic Chemistry 3.1 Alkanols 3.2 Al and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Electrochemistry ● Redox reactions ● Electrochemical cell ● Standard electrode p and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Nuclear Chemistry ● Stability of isotopes ● Chemical and nuclear reactions ● Rad and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
